spot.name: Savoy Summerset Hotel
spot.tagline: International and Nigerian dining, cocktails and poolside evenings in Ikeja GRA
spot.description: Savoy Summerset Hotel sits on Isaac John Street in Ikeja GRA, Lagos. Its restaurant and cocktail bar are open daily from 9am to 11pm, serving full English and Nigerian breakfasts, grilled steaks and lamb chops, prawns thermidor, Mexican favourites, pizzas and a full selection of Nigerian soups and swallows. The bar pours champagne, fine wines, premium spirits and signature cocktails, with the hotel's lit outdoor pool setting the scene in the evening.

reservations.note: For groups larger than 12 or private dining, please call the hotel.
